## New Experiences

It is very hard to adjust from mouse to tablet. The pen is sensitive and keyboard and the drawing pad often show up unexpectedly.

## My Preferences

- Disconnet and reconnect to activate it. Not a tip but I need to do it to see my pen working.
- I always use touch off option.
- I don't enable Windows Ink so that I don't start with ink mode when openning a word document.

## Logitech K380 keyboard: 

I bought the pebble keyboard so that the keyboard and the tablet can fit together on my desk. However, there are no Page Up/Down/Home/End keys.

- Page down and page up can be simulated via `fn + up` and `fn + down`.
- Home button can be setup using logi options
